data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts that the §11.3 flags are 'false positives' on the basis that they 'conflate critic execution failures (timeout, crash) ... with critic unreliability.' But this framing presupposes that execution failures and unreliability are mutually exclusive categories, when in fact a timeout or crash during critic execution IS direct evidence of unreliability under any reasonable reading of 'critic unreliability.' The target thus does not refute the sustained flags; it merely relabels the same fault. Moreover, SRC_001 cites no artifact that actually distinguishes a mechanical execution failure from a substantive reliability lapse — the appeal to the 'sound verdict in SRC_006' is a non-sequitur, since a single sound verdict on one artifact cannot establish reliability across an audit.
